BiblicalUsage: Enosh is the son of Seth, named in the first verse of the Chronicler's genealogy in 1 Chronicles 1:1, and in Genesis 4:26 his birth is the moment when men began to call upon the name of the LORD. Seth lived a hundred and five years and begat Enos in Genesis 5:6, carrying the line of promise forward from Adam.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Enosh matters because his name marks a turning point — the generation that began to call on the LORD by name. His story lives on his People profile.
